Indian Coast Guard Navik / Yantrik CGEPT Exam City Details 2026 – Full Details

Join Indian Coast Guard has released Exam City Details for the recruitment of Navik GD & Yantrik 01/2027 & 02/2027 Batch on the official website. This recruitment has been issued for 365 posts. The online registration process for Indian Coast Guard Navik / Yantrik CGEPT Recruitment 2026 were accepted from06 October 2026, to 21 October 2026. The CBT I examination is going to conducted on 17-18 November 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Indian Coast Guard Navik / Yantrik CGEPT Exam City Details 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 06 October 2026
  • Last Date : 21 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 21 October 2026
  • Online Correction Form : 27 – 28 October 2026
  • Exam Date : 17-18 November 2026
  • Exam City Details : 06 November 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • All Candidates (Other than SC / ST) : Rs. 550/-
  • SC, ST : No Fee
